new_findings.title: WordPress guidance advertises a modal without containing focus
new_findings.defect: The component declares `<div role="dialog" aria-modal="true">` at line 8 but does not move focus into the dialog or contain Tab navigation. Its app route leaves the session escape controls outside the dialog (App.tsx:292-296), despite the modal semantics.
new_findings.failure_scenario: A keyboard user activates the guidance button and App navigates to /keys/wordpress, unmounting the focused trigger. Focus can fall to the document body; pressing Tab can then reach the Clerk or sign-out controls outside the modal while aria-modal=true tells assistive technology that outside content is unavailable.
new_findings.fix: On mount focus a control inside the dialog, trap Tab among its focusable controls, and make the session escape region inert while the guidance is open.
